notes.title: Extraction Valley 2.3 Update is now alive!
notes.content:
[i]In this update, We are bringing you new Turret Items to play PvE and a new Map and Much more.  [/i]

[h1]New Map Greenhill Isle[/h1]
This is how the Forgotten Land looks like before DWB nuke the Isle. Visite before it gets nuked, Agents! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35431461/2eac786ac1bb8038f7db08fe250567e5dc284945.jpg[/img]


[h1]New AI the [b]Behemoth[/b][/h1]
Behemoth was developed by OMAGA Corporation to use in the 1st trifule war. But the war ended before they got a chance to deploy Behemoth OMAGA abandoned the project. Now Titans took over the OMAGA Robotics facility and they reactivated the Behemoth. You can now fight agents him in PvE. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35431461/b19b7eb141e798dfee4edceb30e872fedc8d93b3.png[/img]

[h1]New Utility Items "Turrets"[/h1]
You can now activate Turrets in PvE. Collect ENDEIXS by destroying incoming enemies. And use ENDEXIS to activate Turrets. Turrets level up as it killed enemies and switches firing mods as it levels up. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35431461/e6b702eba2ec1ae2484dc4d5cfc7fa3e5c342e8b.jpg[/img]

[h1]HUD Improvemets[/h1]
You can now see the teammate's health and armor on the HUD.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35431461/7c49d96f7b67e94fd40bc33e8a809e2684876bd2.jpg[/img]


[h3]And some minor Bug fixes and improvements[/h3]

notes.title: Extraction Valley 2.1 Update is now alive!
notes.content:
[h1]Titan Invasion[/h1] New Game Mode
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35431461/350a1cc7cb7efb9ffcee12fd005d69a013a5b13d.png[/img]

Titan Invasion is the new mode that we are introducing to this update. Players also can play this mode solo or Co-Op with friends. Players Objective is to defend the harvester from incoming waves of Titan Robots. More improvements for this game mode is coming soon.

[h1]The Forgotten Land[/h1] New Map
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35431461/d685db3399f053d6566d34624bf4cd2bfea432f9.png[/img]

After DWB uncovers that SOA been using this island as a base of operation DWB nuke the island with a Trifuel Warhead killing everyone and everything on the island. Now only ashes are what remains on this once a beautiful island.

notes.title: Extraction Valley 2.0 Update is now alive!
notes.content:
[h1]What's New[/h1]

[h2]Welcome Agents to Trifuel Alliance[/h2]
[b]Extraction Valley Trifuel Alliance [/b]is the 2nd chapter of the Extraction Valley which takes place after the 1st Trifuel war. In the 1st war, Insurgents lost so many people. Since DWB used Advanced Robotics they kept pushing the SOA army back to their mainland. After countless losses, SOA wanted to expand its Trifuel mining operations so they ally with other factions. They call it Trifuel Alliance. Agents from all over the world were assigned to the extraction site to protect the harvester from any threat. DWB counter-attacked by cloning these agents and their abilities. DWB used them against the original agents who were assigned to protect the harvester and then the 2nd Trifuel war began.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
Unlike our Previous game, Trifuel Alliance is not a Team Deathmatch game. Instead, we focus our game to be more tactical and your death has consequences if you downed, your team can revive you. but if they fall, you are dead. you have to wait until the next round starts to play. Extraction Valley Trifuel Alliance is a 4v4 PvP character base 3rd person shooter game where one team tries to defend the Trifuel Harvester while other team tries to destroy it. Players can choose an Agent to play before entering the match. Each Agent has a set of abilities that players can use. Each Agent has a role to play. There are 4 Agents to choose from. Wait for new agents in upcoming seasons.

[h2]Servers[/h2]
Unlike Extraction Valley Devils' Curse, Trifuel Alliance doesn't use dedicated servers so you and your friends can host a match via steam and play. Players also can search for other's sections and join them.

[h1]Important Notice[/h1]
If you face any control issues while playing the game. just delete the Save Folder located in [i] >ExtractionValley>Saved [/i] after deleted check Steam for an Update.

Stay Home and Play games. 

RAM Studios.

STAND BY AGENTS! ANOTHER WAR IS COMING.

notes.title: Checking In (Weekly Update)
notes.content:
Hay everyone. We know all of you guys are waiting to play this game. As much as we like to release this game to you guys and let you guys play we have some difficulties in our end. As many of you know we are an indie dev team with a small team. At this movement, we are working on fixing bugs and improving the gameplay. Currently, we can't support a large number of players once. it's an 8V8 match so it's a total of 16 players in one match. It may look like a small number but for the servers, it's not. So we have to find a way to support a large number of players once without our servers crying for help 😉.

Aside from that, we are now working on some fixes for some major issues that we found while testing. [b]EV[/b] has some pretty lager maps so finding small map issues isn't an easy job for a small team. 

Our game got approved form steam so we are ready to deploy the game as soon as we address all the issues we mentioned above. We will keep you updated. Follow us on Steam to get the lates news. 

Have a nice day 
[b]RAM STUDIOS TEAM[/b]
